nodes.summary: A group $G$ is metacyclic if it has a cyclic normal subgroup $N$ such that the quotient $G/N$ is cyclic.
nodes.title: Metacyclic group

nodes.summary: Derived length of $p$-groups whose $2$-generator subgroups have cyclic derived subgroups (Kourovka Problem 17.46). Let $p$ be a prime and $G$ a finite $p$-group such that for all $x, y \in G$ the derived subgroup $[H, H]$ of $H = \langle x, y \rangle$ is cyclic. Then $G$ has derived length at most $4$, that is, the fourth term $G^{(4)}$ of the derived series of $G$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Derived length of $p$-groups whose $2$-generator subgroups have cyclic derived subgroups (Kourovka Problem 17.46)

nodes.summary: The statement that for every prime $p$ and every finite $p$-group $G$ such that for all $x, y \in G$ the derived subgroup $[H, H]$ of $H = \langle x, y \rangle$ is cyclic, $G$ has derived length at most $4$, that is, the fourth term $G^{(4)}$ of the derived series of $G$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 17.46, with the bound $4$

nodes.summary: Finite $2$-groups with metacyclic $2$-generator subgroups are metabelian (Kourovka Problem 15.33). Let $G$ be a finite $2$-group such that for all $x, y \in G$ the subgroup $\langle x, y \rangle$ generated by $x$ and $y$ is metacyclic, that is, has a cyclic normal subgroup with cyclic quotient. Then $G$ is metabelian: its second derived subgroup $G''$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Finite $2$-groups with metacyclic $2$-generator subgroups are metabelian (Kourovka Problem 15.33)

nodes.summary: The statement that every finite $2$-group $G$ such that for all $x, y \in G$ the subgroup $\langle x, y \rangle$ generated by $x$ and $y$ is metacyclic has derived length at most $2$, that is, its second derived subgroup $G''$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 15.33, with the bound $2$
